## Services

1. **End-to-End Web Engineering** — bespoke web applications with maintainable
   architecture, tuned data layers and third-party integrations. Server-side
   development (REST/GraphQL endpoints, microservices, identity and access
   management), UI engineering (Next.js, React, Vue, TypeScript) and data
   architecture (SQL/NoSQL tuning, resilient and scalable schemas).
2. **Online Stores & SaaS Platforms** — multi-tenant systems with permission
   layers and tenant boundaries, billing and payment flows (Paystack, Stripe,
   PayPal, regional gateways, subscription lifecycles), admin control panels,
   reporting and workflow automation.
3. **API Development & Connectivity** — tailored REST and GraphQL APIs with
   layered modular design, platform integrations (payment processors, identity
   providers, external services) and security via JWT, OAuth 2.0, request
   validation and throttling.
4. **Speed Tuning & Code Modernization** — legacy code overhaul, Core Web Vitals
   and Lighthouse deep-dives, paint and rendering profiling, caching and database
   query tuning.
5. **Artificial Intelligence Integration & Development** — LLM and generative AI
   integration (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude APIs, prompt engineering,
   RAG pipelines), intelligent features (AI chatbots, smart search, content
   generation, recommendation engines) and ML pipelines (model fine-tuning,
   vector databases, embeddings, AI workflow automation).
